_doc: The Chronicle (ChronicleManager.gd; LIVING_WORLD.md C, H): the world's history. Every news line is weighed (importance by news kind plus keyword boosts); lines at min_importance or above are kept, with the adventurers they name. Capped at max_entries (least important, oldest pruned first). Epithets are earned from deeds; epitaphs remember the fallen by their traits.

epitaphs.cautious: Checked every corner but the last.
epitaphs.ambitious: Reached for the top until the very end.
epitaphs.cowardly: Was braver at the end than anyone knew.
epitaphs.aloof: Kept to themselves, to the end.
epitaphs.default: Fell in the line of duty.

legend._doc: Legend writing (LegendManager.gd): when you retire, your Chronicle becomes a Legend kept across worlds (user://legends.json). Templates use {name}, {race}, {class}, {year}, {season}, {friend}, {rival}, {rank}, {epithet}, {count}, {text}.
legend.origin: In the {season} of Year {year}, a {race} {class} named {name}, born in {birthplace}, came to Nexus and signed their name in the Guild's ledger.
legend.bond: {name} and {friend} swore an oath beneath the Guild's lamps, and kept it.
legend.rival: But {rival} would not be outdone, and the two measured themselves against each other for years.
legend.crowns: Crowned Champion of the Guild {count} time(s), {name} was {epithet_or_famous}.
legend.end: In Year {year}, {name}{epithet_sp} hung up their gear as a {rank} adventurer. The Guild still tells the story.
bard_intro: The bard tunes their lute. "Have you heard of {name}{epithet_sp}?"
"A song from another age," the bard says, "about {name}{epithet_sp}."
The Tavern falls quiet as the bard begins: "{name}{epithet_sp}..."
quotes: The bard sang about {legend}{epithet_sp} again last night. Gives me chills every time.
My grandmother swore she once saw {legend} walk into the Guild.
They say {legend} reached {rank} before hanging up their gear. Imagine that.
Some say {relic} is still out there somewhere, in some boss's hoard.
same_class_quotes: You fight like {legend}, you know - the {class} from the old songs.
Another {class}? The last famous one was {legend}{epithet_sp}. Big boots to fill.
heir_quotes: My family name comes from {ancestor}. I mean to earn it.
Everyone expects me to be like {ancestor}. I'll be better.
{ancestor} rode with {legend}. One day they'll sing about me too.
legend.end_death: In Year {year}, {name}{epithet_sp} fell in {place}, a {rank} adventurer to the last. The Guild lowered its banner.
